title: QUIC RFC 9000 CRYPTO Retransmission Acknowledgment Boundary Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests over Handshake CRYPTO retransmission recovery state, coverage triage regeneration, SpecTrace JSON validation, Release build, full Release no-build test execution, and diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the supported local Handshake CRYPTO retransmission boundary: unacknowledged lost CRYPTO data is rebuilt in a fresh packet, queued repair state is cleared if the original packet is acknowledged, and later CRYPTO frames preserve their nonzero stream offset when retransmitted.
expected_result: Focused tests show a lost Handshake CRYPTO packet is rebuilt with the original bytes in a new packet, a queued repair is not sent after acknowledgment of the original packet, and a later contiguous Handshake CRYPTO frame retransmits with its nonzero CRYPTO stream offset and payload intact.
procedure: Run the focused S13P3-0006 requirement-home filter.
Validate canonical SpecTrace JSON with the core profile.
Run the full Release no-build test suite.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The runtime has an active path and Handshake packet-protection material.
The original CRYPTO packet is tracked in the Handshake packet number space before loss is registered.
Nonzero CRYPTO offset proof first sends contiguous offset-zero data so the egress stream can advance to the later offset.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim hosted interop success, public API behavior, packet-number-space discard behavior, or broader recovery tuning beyond the local CRYPTO repair boundary.

status_summary: Local verification passed on 2026-05-08: focused S13P3-0006 requirement-home filter 3/3, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0789 trace_clean and reports 1,482 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, SpecTrace core validation passed for 511 artifacts, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, full Release no-build suite passed 4,840/4,840, and git diff --check passed with only generated-triage CRLF normalization warnings.
